oa-drw-1.imageProvenance: Publicly readable FastPrep Problem Source image(s) linked from the original page, retrieved separately and personally viewed during packaging. Not immutable assets of the fixed upstream commit; bound here by sha256. Four pages of the original DRW PDF: rules and shape diagram (page 1), STDIN/STDOUT format (page 2), worked examples 1-3 with board diagrams (pages 3-4).
oa-drw-1.rangeDisclosure: Original guarantees kept: width 10, valid input, height never exceeds 100. The original gives no line/piece counts; chosen: at most 200 lines, at most 1000 placements per line. Original multi-line stdin/stdout format kept.
corrections: Upstream md rewrote the task as a single-sequence function; the original multi-line STDIN/STDOUT format is used. The image example Q0 -> 2 is included.
